Name: Sequenced Keys
Description:
Sequenced Keys lets you navigate Timberborn's entire bottom toolbar using only your keyboard — no mouse needed.

Press B to enter sequenced build mode. The toolbar buttons light up with key labels showing which key selects which button (or group of buttons). Press a key to drill down: if it maps to a single button, that button is clicked; if it maps to a group, the group subdivides further until you reach a single button. The buttons on the left side of the toolbar get single-key shortcuts first.

How it works:

Press B to activate sequenced mode
Key labels appear over the toolbar buttons
Press the shown key to select a category or tool
If buttons outnumber available keys, they're grouped — press again to narrow down
A breadcrumb in the status bar tracks your key sequence
Press Escape, right-click, or B again to exit
Default keys (all rebindable):
Q, W, E, R, A, S, D, F, Z, X, C, V, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, T, G

While sequenced mode is active, conflicting game bindings (like game speed on 1/2/3 or transparency on T) are automatically suppressed so your selection keys work without interference. All keys can be rebound in the game's keybinding settings under the "Sequenced Keys" group. You can bind less than the full amount of keys, but expect more menu subdivision keypresses when you do.

Currently incompatible with Moddable Tool Groups / MoreGroups. Let me know if there's any demand for this.

Source: https://github.com/internetcoffeephone/timberborn-modding/tree/main/SequencedKeys
